Keep the answer short (a sentence or two); put this answer into the same reply to the launch-channel message that reads "If it slips we have to redo the press embargo." Replace any placeholder text in that reply with both answers you produced above, clearly labeling which answer corresponds to facebook/react and which corresponds to tensorflow/tensorflow. Add an :eyes: reaction to the message in the design-review chat where the participant said "Step 3 asks for too much before showing any value."

open_ended.question: What license is facebook/react released under and what's its primary programming language?
open_ended.ground_truth: facebook/react is released under the MIT license. Its primary programming language is JavaScript.
open_ended.judge_hint: These exact facts (license and primary language for facebook/react) must appear in the reply message you post as the reply to Priya @priya.nair's message m_004 in the 'launch' channel.

open_ended.ground_truth: tensorflow/tensorflow is an open-source machine learning framework for building and deploying ML models (using dataflow graphs). Its core is primarily implemented in C++, with Python as the main user-facing API.
open_ended.judge_hint: These exact facts (purpose and primary implementation language for tensorflow/tensorflow) must appear in the reply message you post as the reply to Priya @priya.nair's message m_004 in the 'launch' channel.
